title: Design System: Colorful Monster Forge and Rewards

extensions.scope: Monster Forge shop and RewardsArcade spin wheel only
extensions.previewPolicy: Source-backed native Roblox components; no HTML/CSS runtime equivalent or invented browser interaction preview. Primitive values live only in DESIGN.md frontmatter. Synthetic tonal ramps omitted because not present in the native build.

nativeRendering.disabled: Disable gradient and input together; muted text with per-module disabled background and border.
nativeRendering.shopInteraction: Roblox AutoButtonColor; Active and Selectable follow state.
nativeRendering.rewardsInteraction: GuiTheme.ButtonFeedback handles mouse/touch/controller border thickness and gloss offset; enabled state also updates AutoButtonColor.
nativeRendering.artwork: 20 independent icon IDs plus one Sky ID; Fit icons, Crop backdrop; aliases reuse images; Gift fallback; no runtime atlas crop.
nativeRendering.statLayout: Stat icons are siblings of padded labels. Reserve 40px text inset when visible; 28px icon at x6 leaves 6px gap. Hide icons below 250px detail width.
nativeRendering.wheel: Config-defined colors and labels; WedgeParts in ViewportFrame for sectors; fixed native geometric pointer; label groups counter-rotate. No daily reward cards in RewardsArcade.

narrative.overview:
The approved cartoon world uses blue sky and clouds around cream containers, navy text, gold titles, turquoise selection and lime actions. Native Roblox controls carry readable prices, ownership and cooldowns; authored illustrations supply character. Equipment previews remain actual game models.

This refresh replaces the former dark-stone shop record following the approved 2026-10-26 concept and extension to Rewards in `docs/colorful-ui/direction.md`. Scope is `MonsterForge.luau`, `RewardsArcade.luau` and shared `CartoonUI.luau`; other game surfaces retain their own systems. The current RewardsArcade source implements the spin wheel, not daily reward cards. PRODUCT.md still records the older shop approval; its native-platform and server-authority constraints remain applicable.
keyCharacteristics: Sky artwork around bright cream content.
Navy text with gold display headings and lime actions.
Independent uploaded illustrations alongside native controls and model previews.
Native pixel reflow and scrolling, with explicit state labels.

rules.name: The State Accent Rule
rules.body: Selection, ownership and availability must remain understandable through native text and borders independently of illustrations.

dos: **Do** preserve native labels, prices, cooldowns and ownership over decorative art.
**Do** use actual equipment models and server-selected spin results.
**Do** disable the active gradient together with unavailable actions.
**Do** distinguish offline checks, image upload IDs, Studio visual acceptance and public publication.
donts: **Don't** bake prices or action labels into raster images.
**Don't** use emoji or primitive Frame-built substitutes for the authored illustration icons.
**Don't** treat this scoped system as a redesign of unrelated game interfaces.
